chunks: Muhammad ibn Abī ʿUmayr narrated from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, that he said:
When a boy reaches ten years of age, his bequest becomes valid.
ai.seo_question: At what age does a boy’s bequest become legally valid in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the validity of a minor boy’s bequest. It states that once he reaches ten years of age, his will is recognized as valid in law.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5450 - Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr narrated from Aban ibn Uthman from Abd Al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdullah from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), who said:
"When a boy reaches the age of ten, his will becomes valid."
